key_findings: NativeRequestBinding carries typed negative outcome only, not positive Actor or delivery authority.
Plan plus outer Pending retain real original admission/fingerprint/clock; take into Pending clears idle Service binding.
Current external snapshot transfer exports or spools/parses; current historical Begin/root CAS occurs inside writer-held finalization.
HTTP final writer acquisition failure drops Pending without Service completion; this source observation is not a runtime reproduced committed-restore failure.
A future remotely committed relay requires explicit bounded settlement custody and durable uncertain-operation binding; Ready is not CompletedForwardReceipt.
